Subject: Quick follow up + potential opportunity

Hi Naydia,

I wanted to follow up after our last conversation and share something I think could be really valuable for you depending on your long term goals.

I recently connected with a group called entity["company","Ezer Health","med spa acquisition and growth company"]. They specialize in partnering with med spa owners who are either looking to scale, take some chips off the table, or eventually exit, but in a very different way than the typical private equity route.

What stood out to me is that they are not your standard acquisition firm that comes in, rebrands everything, and strips out what made the business special. They are actually very focused on preserving the identity, reputation, and operational model of the med spa. They work alongside the owner rather than replacing them.

A few of the perks:
- You can retain equity and continue to participate in the upside as the business grows  
- Access to capital to expand, open new locations, or invest in equipment and team  
- Operational and backend support without losing control of the brand you built  
- They are flexible in how deals are structured depending on your goals  

Some of the general things they look for:
- Established med spas with consistent revenue and strong reputation  
- Owners who care about growth but also about maintaining quality and culture  
- Clean operations and a willingness to optimize systems over time  

It is a much more founder friendly approach compared to most groups in this space, which is why I thought of you.

No pressure at all, but if this is something you would even be curious to explore, I would be happy to make a warm introduction and facilitate that conversation.

Either way, I would love to stay in touch and continue supporting you however I can.

Talk soon,  
Bethany
